segments.thag16.8:1.3: Pucchāmi taṃ samaṇa etamatthaṃ,‘kathaṃ ṭhito tvaṃ ahamaṭṭhitomhi’”.
segments.thag16.8:2.1: “Ṭhito ahaṃ aṅgulimāla sabbadā, sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ;
segments.thag16.8:2.3: Tuvañca pāṇesu asaññatosi, tasmā ṭhitohaṃ tuvamaṭṭhitosi”.
segments.thag16.8:3.1: “Cirassaṃ vata me mahito mahesī, mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccapādi [paccupādi (sabbattha)];
segments.thag16.8:3.3: Sohaṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ, sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ”.
segments.thag16.8:4.1: Icceva coro asimāvudhañca, sobbhe papāte narake anvakāsi [akiri (ma. ni.2.349)];
segments.thag16.8:4.3: Avandi coro sugatassa pāde, tattheva pabbajjamayāci buddhaṃ.
segments.thag16.8:5.1: Buddho ca kho kāruṇiko mahesi, yo satthā lokassa sadevakassa;
segments.thag16.8:5.3: ‘Tamehi bhikkhū’ti tadā avoca, eseva tassa ahu bhikkhubhāvo.
segments.thag16.8:6.1: “Yo ca pubbe pamajjitvā, pacchā so nappamajjati;
segments.thag16.8:6.3: Somaṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā muttova candimā.
segments.thag16.8:7.1: “Yassa pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ, kusalena pidhīyati [pithīyati (sī. syā.)];
segments.thag16.8:7.3: Somaṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā muttova candimā.
segments.thag16.8:8.3: Somaṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā muttova candimā.
segments.thag16.8:9.1: [disā hi (syā. ka., ma. ni.2.352)]“Disāpi me dhammakathaṃ suṇantu, disāpi me yuñjantu buddhasāsane;
segments.thag16.8:9.3: Disāpi me te manuje bhajantu, ye dhammamevādapayanti santo.
segments.thag16.8:11.1: “Na hi jātu so mamaṃ hiṃse, aññaṃ vā pana kiñcanaṃ [kañcinaṃ (sī. syā.), kañcanaṃ (?)];
segments.thag16.8:12.3: Dāruṃ namayanti [damayanti (ka.)] tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti paṇḍitā.
segments.thag16.8:14.3: Ajjāhaṃ saccanāmomhi, na naṃ hiṃsāmi kiñcanaṃ [kañcinaṃ (sī. syā.), kañcanaṃ (?)].
segments.thag16.8:19.3: Appamatto hi jhāyanto, pappoti paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
segments.thag16.8:21.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
